entries.title: A card picked from the count's menu on your iPhone or iPad always shows
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, a quick tap on a card in the menu under the card count sometimes did nothing and left the menu open, most often just after a new card arrived. The tap now shows that card every time.
entries.noPicture: The count and its menu look as they did; only a tap that was lost now shows its card.
